senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; next w.) sated, filled, satisfied.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 56a:8">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>יוצא כשהוא ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00870"><he>רָעֵב</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:13">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>לשְׂבֵעוֹ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00870"><he>רָעֵב</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U00164"><he>שְׂבֵעִים</he></cite>, <he>שְׂבֵעִין</he>, <he>שְׂבֵי׳</he>. Joma 74ᵇ <he>סומין … ואינו ש׳</he> blind persons eat and are not satisfied.

Taan. 10ᵇ אל תראו עצמיכם בפני בני עשו … כאילו אתם ש׳ Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) make no show of your plenty before the sons of Esau or of Ishmael, lest they envy you; Yalk. Gen. 148; a. e.—Fem. שְׂבֵעָה, שְׂבֵי׳.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:10">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> top the Lord allows the righteous in this world to see their (future) reward, <he>ונפשם ש׳ וכ׳</he> and they feel satisfied and go to sleep; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׂבֵעוֹת</he>, <he>שְׂבֵי׳</he>. Midr. Sam. ch. XIII (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 9:12">I Sam. IX, 12</cite>, sq.) <he>וכל האורך הזה … ולא היו ש׳ ממנו</he> why this lengthy speech? It intimates that they looked at the beauty of Saul and could not see enough of it; a. e.
